title: Four years on the ABC staff: conductors and the reed section
summary: The reed section had been on notice until he arrived. He worked under Joe Rines, Paul Lavalle and others and on shows including Don McNeil's Breakfast Club and Paul Whiteman's Connie Boswell show.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And on that network I played with the guys like -- the conductors, the first fellow was Joe Rines, if you remember. Joe Rines, I made audition for him and we had Sid Stoneberg, Salton Seller (PHONETIC) and Louis Martin on alto, Sid Stone was the lead alto and then Salton Seller was playing clarinet and tenor and then I was on the other tenor.

Well, I remember definitely when we made the audition. And they had us to go up to the mike and play and sit down, play blending and all that. So now later on I was told by Sid Stoneberg that the whole reed section was on notice until I came in there. And when I came in they cancelled all the notices.

So I was over there on that staff for four years. And the conductors were like Joe Rines and Paul Levalle (PHONETIC) that did "Lower Basin Street" with Paul Levalle. Nathan Van Cleave (PHONETIC), Bernard Green, Joe Stokepack. And I did the Don McNeil's Breakfast Show whenever it came there, under the direction of Eddie Balentine. And then when Paul Mike Whiteman
came up there as the president, he was conducting the Connie Boswell Show and I was in that orchestra, too.
